Add 1 chopped onion and 2 crushed garlic cloves, then fry for 3 minutes.
Add 300 g frozen chopped spinach and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir 150 g cream-cheese, 150 ml fresh-milk into penne; season 1 pinch table-salt, 1 pinch black-pepper.

recipes.title: Soya and Vegetable Stir-Fry with Rice
steps: Boil 300 g white rice in 600 ml water for 15 minutes.
Rehydrate 150 g soya mince in hot water for 5 minutes, then drain.
Heat 2 tbsp cooking-oil; fry 1 onion, 3 garlic cloves 2 minutes.
Add soya-mince and 400 g frozen-mixed-vegetables; stir-fry 5 minutes.
Add 3 tbsp soy-sauce, 1 tsp sesame-oil; toss and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Braaied Boerewors with Pap and Relish
steps: Boil 900 ml water; whisk 250 g maize-meal, 1 pinch table-salt; simmer 15 minutes.
Braai 600 g boerewors over medium coals 15 minutes, turning until browned/cooked.
Chop 3 tomatoes, 2 onions, 2 green-chillies; mix with 2 tbsp vinegar into relish.
Serve the boerewors with the pap and tomato relish.

recipes.title: Chickpea and Spinach Curry
steps: Fry 1 onion, 3 crushed garlic, 1 tsp ginger in 2 tbsp cooking-oil 3 minutes.
Add 2 tbsp curry-powder, 3 chopped tomatoes, 1 pinch table-salt; cook 5 minutes.
Add 2 cans drained chickpeas, 300 g frozen-chopped-spinach; cook 5 minutes.
Pour in 1 can coconut milk and simmer for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Chicken and Vegetable Stew
steps: Brown 600 g chicken thighs in 2 tbsp cooking oil for 5 minutes.
Add 2 chopped onions and 1 tsp curry powder, then cook for 3 minutes.
Add 3 chopped tomatoes, 2 stock-cubes, 700 ml tap-water, 1 pinch table-salt; simmer 15 min.
Add 4 cubed potatoes, 3 chopped carrots; simmer 25 min until tender.

recipes.title: Cheesy Vegetable Pasta Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C and boil 300 g penne for 8 minutes.
Melt 40 g margarine; stir 3 tbsp cake-flour; whisk 400 ml fresh-milk, 1 tsp mustard, 1 pinch table-salt.
Stir 150 g cheddar-cheese into sauce; season 1 pinch black-pepper.
Mix sauce, 400 g frozen-mixed-vegetables through penne; spoon into baking dish.
Top with the remaining 50 g cheddar and bake at 180 °C for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Creamy Chicken and Spinach Pap
steps: Boil 900 ml water, 1 pinch table-salt; whisk in 250 g maize-meal; simmer 15 minutes, stirring.
Slice 400 g chicken-breasts and brown in 2 tbsp cooking-oil 6 minutes.
Add 1 chopped onion and 2 crushed garlic cloves, then fry for 3 minutes.
Add 300 g frozen-chopped-spinach, 100 g cream-cheese; cook 4 minutes; season 1 pinch black-pepper.
Serve the creamy chicken and spinach over the pap.

recipes.title: Butter Bean Curry with Rice
steps: Boil 300 g white rice in 600 ml water for 15 minutes.
Fry 1 onion, 3 garlic, 1 tsp ginger in 2 tbsp cooking-oil 3 min.
Stir in 2 tbsp curry-powder and 3 chopped tomatoes; cook 5 minutes.
Add 2 cans drained butter-beans, 1 can coconut-milk, 1 pinch table-salt; simmer 10 minutes.
Scatter 1 handful chopped coriander and serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Stuffed Green Peppers
steps: Heat oven 190 °C; boil 200 g white-rice in 500 ml water 12 minutes, drain.
Halve 4 green peppers lengthways and scoop out the seeds.
Fry 1 onion, 2 garlic cloves, 2 tomatoes in 1 tbsp cooking-oil 4 minutes.
Mix fried mixture with rice, 1 can baked-beans, 1 tsp mixed-herbs, 1 pinch table-salt.
Fill pepper halves, top with 100 g cheddar-cheese; bake 190 °C 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegetable Potjie
steps: Heat 2 tbsp cooking-oil in heavy pot; layer 2 onions, 3 garlic on bottom.
Layer 4 sliced potatoes, 3 carrots, 400 g butternut and 200 g green-beans on top.
Add 3 tomatoes, 2 stock-cubes, 1 tsp mixed-herbs, 1 pinch table-salt; pour in 500 ml water.
Cover; simmer gently 40 minutes without stirring, letting layers steam.

recipes.title: Spinach and Feta Pie
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C and thaw 400 g frozen puff pastry.
Squeeze excess water out of 600 g frozen chopped spinach after thawing.
Fry 1 onion, 2 garlic, 1 tbsp cooking-oil 3 minutes; add spinach 3 minutes.
Beat 4 eggs with 100 ml fresh-milk, 1 pinch table-salt and 1 pinch black-pepper.
Line pie dish with half pastry; add spinach mixture, 200 g feta-cheese.
Pour over egg mixture; cover with remaining pastry, bake 200 °C 30 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Beef and Butternut Stew
steps: Brown 600 g beef stewing pieces in 2 tbsp cooking oil for 6 minutes.
Add 2 chopped onions and 2 crushed garlic cloves and fry for 3 minutes.
Add 3 chopped tomatoes, 2 stock-cubes, 1 tsp mixed-herbs, 700 ml water, 1 pinch table-salt.
Cover and simmer for 40 minutes.
Add 600 g cubed butternut; simmer 20 minutes until tender and sauce thickens.

recipes.title: Chicken Livers with Pap
steps: Boil 900 ml tap-water, 1 pinch table-salt; whisk 250 g maize-meal; simmer 15 min, stirring.
Rinse and trim 500 g chicken livers and season with 1 pinch black pepper.
Fry 2 chopped onions, 2 crushed garlic in 2 tbsp cooking-oil 4 min.
Add 1 tsp curry powder and 3 chopped tomatoes, then cook for 5 minutes.
Add the livers and cook for 6 minutes, stirring, until just cooked through.
Serve the livers and tomato sauce over the pap.

recipes.title: Vegetable Biryani
steps: Peel and cube 3 potatoes and chop 2 carrots.
Melt 40 g butter; fry 2 onions, 3 garlic, 1 tsp ginger till golden.
Add 2 tbsp biryani-spice, potatoes, carrots, 400 g frozen-mixed-vegetables, 150 g plain-yoghurt, 1 pinch table-salt; cook 8 min.
Parboil 400 g basmati rice in 800 ml water for 8 minutes, then drain.
Layer rice over vegetables; cover tightly and steam low 15 minutes to merge flavours.

recipes.title: Kerrie-en-Appelkoos Chicken (Curry and Apricot Chicken)
steps: Brown 600 g chicken thighs in 2 tbsp cooking oil for 5 minutes.
Add 2 chopped onions and 2 crushed garlic cloves and fry for 3 minutes.
Cook 2 tbsp curry-powder, 3 tbsp apricot-jam, 2 tbsp fruit-chutney, 3 tomatoes 4 minutes.
Simmer 300 ml water, 1 pinch salt 20 min covered until chicken done; sauce glosses.
Boil 300 g white-rice in remaining 600 ml water 15 minutes; serve with curry.

recipes.title: Cape Malay Bobotie
steps: Heat oven to 180 °C; soak 2 white-bread slices in 100 ml fresh-milk.
Fry 2 onions, 2 garlic cloves in 2 tbsp cooking-oil 4 minutes.
Add 2 tbsp curry powder and 1 tsp turmeric, then cook for 1 minute.
Brown 500 g beef-mince 6 min; stir 2-tbsp fruit-chutney, 1-tbsp vinegar, 1-tsp mixed-herbs, 1-pinch each table-salt/black-pepper.
Squeeze bread into mince; press mixture into baking dish.
Beat 2 eggs with remaining 100 ml fresh-milk; pour over; bake 180 °C 30 min until set.

recipes.title: Tomato Bredie
steps: Brown 600 g mutton stewing pieces in 2 tbsp cooking oil for 6 minutes.
Add 2 chopped onions and 2 crushed garlic cloves and fry for 3 minutes.
Add 6 chopped tomatoes and 2 tbsp tomato-paste; cook 8 minutes until broken down.
Add 2 stock-cubes, 500 ml water, 1 pinch salt and black-pepper; cover, simmer 35 minutes.
Add 4 quartered potatoes; simmer 15 minutes until tender and sauce thickened.

recipes.title: Chicken Potjie
steps: Heat 2 tbsp cooking-oil in potjie pot; brown 700 g chicken-thighs 5 minutes.
Layer 2 sliced onions, 3 garlic, 3 tomatoes, 1 green-pepper, 3 carrots, 4 potatoes.
Add 2 stock-cubes, 1 tsp curry-powder, 1 pinch table-salt and 500 ml water.
Cover; simmer gently 40 minutes without stirring, letting layers steam.

recipes.title: Lamb Potjie
steps: Heat 2 tbsp cooking-oil in potjie pot; brown 700 g lamb-stewing-pieces 7 minutes.
Layer 2 sliced onions, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 3 chopped tomatoes, 3 chopped carrots, 5 halved potatoes.
Add 2 stock-cubes, 2 tsp mixed-herbs, 1 pinch table-salt, 1 pinch black-pepper and 600 ml water.
Cover and simmer gently for 70 minutes without stirring until the lamb is tender.

recipes.title: Durban Bunny Chow
steps: Fry 2 onions, 3 garlic, 2 tsp ginger in 3 tbsp cooking-oil until golden.
Add 3 tbsp curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add 4 chopped tomatoes and 1 pinch salt, then cook for 5 minutes.
Add 600 g chicken thighs and brown for 5 minutes.
Add 600 ml water, 3 potatoes; simmer 30 minutes until chicken cooked, gravy thick.
Cut 1 white-bread loaf into 4 thick blocks; hollow centres; fill each with curry.

recipes.title: Vetkoek with Savoury Mince
steps: Fry 1 onion, 2 grated carrots in 1 tbsp cooking-oil 3 minutes.
Add 400 g beef mince and brown for 5 minutes.
Add 2 tbsp tomato-paste, 1 stock-cube, 1 tsp curry-powder, 1 pinch table-salt, 200 ml water; simmer 10 minutes.
Add 100 g frozen peas and cook for 3 minutes.
Warm 8 vetkoek and split them open, then fill with the savoury mince.

recipes.title: Pork Chops with Apple Sauce and Pap
steps: Boil 900-ml tap-water and 1-pinch table-salt; whisk in 250-g maize-meal, simmer 15 minutes stirring.
Season 4 pork-chops, 1-pinch table-salt, 1-pinch black-pepper; fry 2-tbsp cooking-oil 5 minutes per side.
Peel-chop 3 apples, 1 onion; simmer 30-g butter, 2-tbsp white-sugar, 2-tbsp water 12 min soft.
Mash the apple mixture lightly to make a chunky sauce.
Serve the pork chops with the pap and apple sauce.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
steps: Boil 300 g white rice in 600 ml water for 15 minutes.
Slice 500 g beef-stewing-pieces into strips, then brown in 30 g butter 5 minutes.
Add 1 chopped onion, 2 crushed garlic, 250 g mushrooms; fry 5 minutes.
Stir cake-flour 1 tbsp, sour-cream 200 g, mustard 1 tsp, table-salt/black-pepper 1 pinch each.
Simmer gently for 5 minutes and serve over the rice.

recipes.title: Chicken and Broccoli Stir-Fry
steps: Boil 300 g white rice in 600 ml water for 15 minutes.
Slice 500 g chicken-breasts into strips; stir-fry in 2 tbsp cooking-oil 5 minutes.
Add 1 chopped onion, 3 crushed garlic, 1 tsp grated ginger; fry 2 minutes.
Add 1 head broccoli florets, 2 sliced carrots; stir-fry 5 minutes.
Pour in 3 tbsp soy-sauce, 1 tsp sesame-oil; toss and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Meatloaf with Mashed Potatoes
steps: Heat oven to 180 °C; soak 2 white-bread slices in 100 ml fresh-milk.
Mix 600 g beef-mince, 1 onion, 2 eggs, 1 tsp mixed-herbs, 1 pinch table-salt, 1 pinch black-pepper, bread.
Press mixture into loaf tin; top 3 tbsp tomato-sauce mixed with 1 tbsp worcestershire-sauce.
Bake at 180 °C for 40 minutes.
Boil 6 potatoes 15 minutes; mash with 40 g butter and splash of milk.
Slice the meatloaf and serve with the mash.

recipes.title: Spaghetti and Meatballs
steps: Mix 400 g beef-mince, 1 white-bread slice, 1 egg, 1 pinch table-salt, 1 pinch black-pepper; roll meatballs.
Brown the meatballs in 2 tbsp cooking oil for 6 minutes, then set aside.
Fry 1 onion, 2 garlic 3 min; 4 tomatoes, 2 tbsp tomato-paste, 1 tsp mixed-herbs; simmer 10 min.
Return the meatballs to the sauce and simmer gently for 10 minutes.
Boil 300 g spaghetti for 10 minutes and serve with the meatballs and sauce.

recipes.title: Chicken Stew with Dumplings
steps: Brown 700 g chicken thighs in 2 tbsp cooking oil for 5 minutes.
Add 2 chopped onions and 1 tsp curry powder and fry for 3 minutes.
Add 2 stock-cubes, 800 ml water, 1 pinch table-salt; cover and simmer 25 minutes.
Add 3 chopped carrots and 4 cubed potatoes and simmer for 15 minutes.
Rub 50 g margarine into 200 g self-raising-flour, 1 pinch table-salt; add 120 ml fresh-milk for soft dough.
Drop dough spoonfuls onto simmering stew; cover and steam 15 minutes without lifting lid.

recipes.title: Grilled Fish with Roast Vegetables
steps: Heat oven to 200 °C; chunk 4 potatoes, 3 carrots, 400 g butternut, 1 onion.
Toss vegetables in 2 tbsp cooking-oil, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tsp mixed-herbs, 1 pinch table-salt; roast 30 min.
Rub 600 g hake-fillets with remaining 1 tbsp cooking-oil; season 1 pinch table-salt, 1 pinch black-pepper.
Grill the fish for 4 minutes per side until it flakes easily.
Serve the fish with the roast vegetables and a squeeze of 1 lemon.

recipes.title: Sausage and Mash with Gravy
steps: Boil 8 peeled potatoes 15 minutes; mash with 50 g butter, 100 ml fresh-milk, 1 pinch table-salt.
Brown 6 pork-sausages in 1 tbsp cooking-oil 12 minutes, turning until cooked through.
Add 2 sliced onions; fry 4 minutes, then stir in 1 tbsp cake-flour.
Pour 250 ml water and 1 stock-cube; simmer 5 minutes, season with 1 pinch black-pepper.
Serve the sausages and gravy over the mash.

recipes.title: Chicken and Chickpea Curry
steps: Fry 1 onion, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp ginger in 2 tbsp cooking-oil 3 minutes.
Add 2 tbsp curry powder and 3 chopped tomatoes, then cook for 5 minutes.
Add 500 g chicken thighs and brown for 5 minutes.
Combine 1 can chickpeas, 1 can coconut-milk, 200 ml tap-water, 1 pinch table-salt; simmer 20 min until cooked.
Scatter with 1 handful chopped coriander before serving.

recipes.title: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
steps: Boil 300 g white rice in 600 ml water for 15 minutes.
Slice 500 g beef stewing pieces into thin strips.
Heat 2 tbsp cooking-oil in wok; stir-fry beef 5 minutes until browned.
Add 1 chopped onion, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp grated ginger; stir-fry 2 min.
Add 1 head broccoli cut into florets and stir-fry for 4 minutes.
Pour in 3 tbsp soy-sauce and 1 tsp sesame-oil; toss and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Shakshuka
steps: Fry 1 onion, 3 garlic cloves, 1 green-pepper in 2 tbsp cooking-oil 4 minutes.
Stir 1 tsp chilli-powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp ground-cumin; cook 1 minute.
Add 6 chopped tomatoes, 1 pinch table-salt; simmer 10 minutes until thick.
Make 6 wells in the sauce and crack 1 egg into each.
Cover; cook low 6 minutes until whites set, yolks soft.
Scatter with 1 handful chopped coriander and serve with 4 toasted white bread slices.

recipes.title: Spanish Omelette (Potato Tortilla)
steps: Peel 4 potatoes and slice them thinly, then slice 1 onion.
Heat 3 tbsp cooking-oil; gently fry potatoes and onion 12 minutes, soft not brown.
Beat 6 eggs, 1 pinch table-salt, 1 pinch black-pepper; add potatoes and onion.
Heat 1 tbsp cooking-oil; pour egg mixture, cook low 6 minutes until almost set.
Flip omelette with a plate; slide back into pan, cook 3 minutes more.

recipes.title: Chicken Pie
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C and thaw 400 g frozen puff pastry.
Cube 500 g chicken-breasts and brown in 1 tbsp cooking-oil for 6 minutes.
Add 1 chopped onion and 2 chopped carrots, then fry for 4 minutes.
Melt 40 g butter; stir 3 tbsp cake-flour, 300 ml fresh-milk, 1 stock-cube until thick.
Mix chicken, vegetables, 150 g frozen-peas, sauce, 1 pinch table-salt, 1 pinch black-pepper; spoon into dish.
Top with pastry; seal edges and bake at 200 °C for 30 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Mutton and Bean Curry
steps: Fry 2 onions, 3 garlic cloves and 1 tsp ginger in 2 tbsp cooking-oil 4 minutes.
Add 2 tbsp curry powder and 4 chopped tomatoes, then cook for 5 minutes.
Add 600 g mutton pieces and brown for 6 minutes.
Pour in 500 ml water and 1 pinch table-salt; cover and simmer 40 minutes.
Add 3 cubed potatoes and 2 cans drained butter-beans; simmer 15 minutes until tender.

recipes.title: Fish Pie
steps: Heat oven to 180 °C and boil 6 peeled potatoes 15 minutes until soft.
Poach 500 g hake-fillets in 300 ml fresh-milk 6 minutes; lift fish, reserve milk.
Melt 40 g butter, stir 3 tbsp cake-flour, whisk reserved milk, 1 pinch salt/black-pepper.
Flake fish, discard skin, bones; fold into sauce with 1 onion, 150 g frozen-peas.
Spoon into baking dish and mash potatoes with remaining 10 g butter.
Top pie with mash and 80 g cheddar; bake at 180 °C 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Frikkadel with Rice
steps: Soak 2 white bread slices in water, then squeeze dry.
Mix 500 g beef-mince, bread, egg, onion, garlic, 1 tsp mixed-herbs, 1 pinch salt/black-pepper.
Shape into small balls and brown in 2 tbsp cooking oil for 6 minutes.
Remove frikkadel; fry 1 onion, 3 tomatoes, 1 tbsp tomato-paste 5 minutes.
Return frikkadel to pan with 200 ml water; simmer 12 minutes.
Boil 300 g white-rice in remaining 700 ml water 15 minutes; serve with frikkadel.

recipes.title: Bean Burritos
steps: Fry 1 chopped onion, 2 crushed garlic clove in 1 tbsp cooking-oil for 3 minutes.
Stir 1 tsp chilli-powder, 1 tsp ground-cumin; add 3 chopped tomatoes, 1 pinch table-salt, cook 5 minutes.
Add 1 can drained four-bean-mix, 1 can sweetcorn; cook 4 minutes.
Warm 4 tortillas in dry pan; fill each with bean mixture, 100 g grated cheddar-cheese.
Roll up and serve.

recipes.title: Sausage Tray Bake with Vegetables
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C.
Chop 5 potatoes, 3 carrots, 400 g butternut, 1 onion; spread in roasting tray.
Toss 2 tbsp cooking-oil, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp mixed-herbs, 1 pinch table-salt and 1 pinch black-pepper.
Slice 6 russian sausages and scatter over the vegetables.
Roast at 200 °C 35 minutes, turning once halfway, until vegetables golden and sausage cooked.

recipes.title: Lentil and Sausage Stew
steps: Slice 400 g russian-sausages; brown in 1 tbsp cooking-oil 5 minutes.
Add 1 onion, 3 carrots, 2 crushed garlic cloves; fry 4 minutes.
Stir in 3 tomatoes and 1 tbsp tomato-paste; cook 4 minutes.
Add 200 g dry-red-lentils, 2 stock-cubes, 1 tsp mixed-herbs, 800 ml water, 1 pinch each table-salt/black-pepper.
Cover; simmer 25 minutes until lentils soft and stew thick.

recipes.title: Chicken Curry with Roti
steps: Fry 2 onions, 3 garlic cloves, 1 tsp ginger in 2 tbsp cooking-oil until golden.
Add 2 tbsp curry powder and 3 chopped tomatoes, then cook for 5 minutes.
Add 600 g chicken thighs and brown for 5 minutes.
Add 2 potatoes, 300 ml tap-water, 1 pinch table-salt; simmer covered 20 min until chicken cooked.
Warm 4 roti and serve with the curry scattered with 1 handful chopped coriander.

recipes.title: Lamb and Apricot Stew
steps: Brown 600 g lamb stewing pieces in 2 tbsp cooking oil for 6 minutes.
Add 2 chopped onions and 2 crushed garlic cloves and fry for 3 minutes.
Stir in 3 tbsp apricot-jam, 2 tbsp fruit-chutney and 3 chopped tomatoes; cook 5 min.
Add 2 stock-cubes, 600 ml water and 1 pinch table-salt; cover and simmer 50 min.
Add 3 cubed potatoes; simmer 15 min until tender and sauce glossy.

recipes.title: Chickpea and Potato Curry
steps: Peel and cube 4 potatoes and boil them for 8 minutes.
Fry 1 onion, 3 crushed garlic, 1 tsp ginger in 2 tbsp cooking-oil 3 minutes.
Add 2 tbsp curry powder and 3 chopped tomatoes, then cook for 5 minutes.
Add potatoes, 2 cans drained chickpeas, 1 can coconut-milk, 200 ml water, 1 pinch table-salt; simmer 12 minutes.
Scatter with 1 handful chopped coriander before serving.

recipes.title: Beef and Green Bean Stir-Fry
steps: Boil 300 g white rice in 600 ml water for 15 minutes.
Slice 500 g beef into thin strips; top and tail 400 g green-beans.
Heat 2 tbsp cooking-oil in wok; stir-fry beef 5 minutes until browned.
Add 1 chopped onion, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp grated ginger; stir-fry 2 min.
Add the green beans and stir-fry for 4 minutes.
Pour in 3 tbsp soy-sauce and 1 tsp sesame-oil; toss and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Egg Curry with Rice
steps: Boil 6 eggs for 8 minutes, then peel and halve them.
Boil 300 g white rice in 600 ml water for 15 minutes.
Fry 1 onion, 3 garlic, 1 tsp ginger in 2 tbsp cooking-oil 3 minutes.
Add 2 tbsp curry powder and 3 chopped tomatoes, then cook for 5 minutes.
Pour 1 can coconut-milk, 1 pinch table-salt; simmer 5 minutes.
Add eggs, heat through 3 minutes; scatter 1 handful coriander; serve over rice.

recipes.title: Pork and Apple Stew
steps: Brown 4 pork-chops in 2 tbsp cooking-oil 5 minutes per side; set aside.
Fry 2 chopped onions, 2 crushed garlic cloves in same pan 3 minutes.
Add 3 peeled-chopped apples, 2 stock-cubes, 1-tsp mixed-herbs, 600-ml water, 1-pinch table-salt, 1-pinch black-pepper.
Return the pork chops to the pan, cover and simmer for 25 minutes.
Add 4 cubed potatoes; simmer 20 minutes until tender and sauce thickened.

recipes.title: Bean and Vegetable Curry
steps: Peel and cube 3 potatoes and boil them for 8 minutes.
Fry 1 chopped onion, 3 crushed garlic clove in 2 tbsp cooking-oil for 3 minutes.
Add 2 tbsp curry powder and 3 chopped tomatoes, then cook for 5 minutes.
Add potatoes, 400 g frozen-mixed-vegetables, 2 can drained four-bean-mix, 1 can coconut-milk, 200 ml tap-water, 1 pinch table-salt.
Simmer for 15 minutes until the vegetables are tender.

recipes.title: Beef and Noodle Stir-Fry
steps: Cook 300 g egg noodles according to the packet, then drain.
Slice 500 g beef into thin strips; shred 300 g cabbage and 2 carrots.
Heat 2 tbsp cooking-oil in wok; stir-fry beef 5 minutes.
Add 1 chopped onion and 3 crushed garlic cloves, then stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add the cabbage and carrots and stir-fry for 4 minutes.
Add noodles, 3 tbsp soy-sauce, 1 tsp sesame-oil; toss 2 minutes and serve.

recipes.title: Mutton and Vegetable Soup
steps: Brown 500 g mutton stewing pieces in 1 tbsp cooking oil for 6 minutes.
Add 2 onions, 2 garlic cloves and 2 tbsp tomato-paste; cook 3 minutes.
Add 2 stock-cubes, 1 tsp mixed-herbs, 1.5 l tap-water, 1 pinch table-salt; simmer covered 45 minutes.
Add 3 carrots and 3 cubed potatoes; simmer 20 minutes until tender.

recipes.title: Pumpkin and Lentil Curry
steps: Fry 1 onion, 3 garlic cloves, 1 tsp ginger, 2 tbsp cooking-oil, 3 minutes.
Add 2 tbsp curry powder and 3 chopped tomatoes, then cook for 5 minutes.
Add 600 g pumpkin, 150 g dry-red-lentils, 1 can coconut-milk, 400 ml water, 1 pinch table-salt.
Simmer for 20 minutes until the pumpkin and lentils are soft.

recipes.title: Sausage and Potato Hash
steps: Dice 5 potatoes and boil them for 8 minutes, then drain.
Slice 500 g russian-sausages and brown them in 2 tbsp cooking-oil for 5 minutes.
Add 1 chopped onion and 1 chopped green pepper and fry for 3 minutes.
Add potatoes, 1 tsp paprika; fry 8 minutes golden; season 1 pinch table-salt and 1 pinch black-pepper.
Make 4 wells; crack 1 egg into each, cover, cook 5 minutes until set.

recipes.title: Fish and Potato Stew
steps: Fry 1 onion, 2 crushed garlic cloves in 2 tbsp cooking-oil 3 minutes.
Add 3 tomatoes, 1 tbsp tomato-paste, 1 stock-cube, 1 tsp mixed-herbs, 400 ml water; simmer 5 min.
Add 5 cubed potatoes, 1 pinch salt; simmer 15 minutes until almost tender.
Cut 600 g hake-fillets into chunks; lay in stew, simmer 10 min till flakes.

recipes.title: Beef and Vegetable Soup
steps: Brown 500 g beef stewing pieces in 1 tbsp cooking oil for 6 minutes.
Add 2 chopped onions, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tbsp tomato-paste; cook 3 minutes.
Add 2 stock-cubes, 1 tsp mixed-herbs, 1.5 l water, 1 pinch table-salt; simmer covered 45 min.
Add 3 chopped carrots, 3 cubed potatoes; simmer 20 minutes until tender.

recipes.title: Traditional Milk Tart (Melktert)
steps: Heat 180 °C; rub 100 g butter into 200 g cake-flour, 50 g icing-sugar; press pastry into dish.
Bake the crust blind at 180 °C for 15 minutes until pale gold, then cool.
Whisk 60 g cake-flour, 40 g corn-flour, 150 g white-sugar, 4 eggs, 200 ml fresh-milk to smooth paste.
Heat remaining 800 ml fresh-milk to just below boiling; whisk into egg mixture.
Return mixture; cook low 8 minutes stirring to thick; add 30 g butter, 2 tsp vanilla-essence.
Pour filling into crust; smooth top; dust 1 tsp ground-cinnamon; chill before slicing.

recipes.title: Melkkos
steps: Rub 50 g butter into 200 g cake-flour and 1 pinch table-salt until coarse crumbs.
Bring 1 l fresh milk to a gentle simmer in a wide pot.
Drop flour mixture in pinches, stirring into soft lumps; simmer 10 minutes, stirring often.
Stir in 3 tbsp white-sugar; serve hot with 1 tsp ground-cinnamon dusted over bowls.

recipes.title: Bread Pudding with Custard
steps: Heat oven to 180 °C; butter baking dish with 10 g butter.
Tear 8 white-bread slices into chunks; spread in dish with 80 g sultanas.
Beat 3 eggs, 300 ml fresh-milk, 100 g white-sugar, 1 tsp vanilla-essence; pour over bread.
Dot 30 g butter, dust 1 tsp ground-cinnamon; bake 180 °C 35 minutes until set/golden.
Heat 300 ml fresh-milk; whisk 3 tbsp custard-powder, 30 g white-sugar; serve over pudding.

recipes.title: Koeksisters
steps: Boil 400 g white-sugar, 250 ml water, 3 tbsp golden-syrup, 1 tsp ground-cinnamon 5 min; chill in fridge.
Rub 50 g butter into 400 g cake-flour, 4 tsp baking-powder and 1 pinch table-salt.
Mix in 1 egg and 150 ml fresh-milk to soft dough; rest 20 minutes.
Roll the dough out, cut into strips and plait them into koeksisters.
Heat 1 l cooking-oil to 180 °C; fry koeksisters in batches 3 min until golden; drain.
Dip hot koeksisters straight into ice-cold syrup 30 seconds; lift onto rack.

recipes.title: Self-Saucing Chocolate Pudding
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C and grease a deep baking dish.
Beat 150 g white-sugar with 1 egg, 60 g melted butter, 1 tsp vanilla-essence.
Fold 150 g cake-flour, 2 tbsp cocoa-powder, 2 tsp baking-powder, 1 pinch table-salt, 150 ml fresh-milk into dish.
Mix remaining 100 g white-sugar, 3 tbsp cocoa-powder, 250 ml water; pour gently over batter, don't stir.
Bake at 180 °C 30 minutes until top set and sauce forms underneath.

recipes.title: Creamy Rice Pudding
steps: Rinse 150 g white-rice; put in pot with 1 l fresh-milk and 1 pinch table-salt.
Bring to gentle simmer; cook 35 minutes, stirring often.
Stir in 80 g white-sugar, 20 g butter, 50 g sultanas; cook 5 minutes until creamy.
Serve warm or chilled with 1 tsp ground cinnamon dusted over the top.

recipes.title: Lemon Meringue Pie
steps: Crush 1 packet tennis-biscuits; mix 80 g melted butter; press into dish; chill 15 min.
Separate 3 eggs, keeping the whites for the topping.
Whisk yolks, 1 can condensed-milk, 4 lemons juice/zest, 2 tbsp corn-flour; cook 6 minutes.
Spoon the lemon filling into the chilled crust.
Whisk 3 whites, gradually add 150 g white-sugar to stiff peaks; pile over filling.
Grill 3 minutes until meringue golden; chill 30 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Tameletjies (Golden Syrup Sweets)
steps: Put 250 ml golden-syrup, 200 g white-sugar, 50 g butter, 1 tbsp vinegar, 1 pinch table-salt in pot.
Boil gently 20 minutes without stirring until a drop sets hard in cold water.
Remove from heat; stir in 1 tsp bicarbonate-of-soda — mixture foams up.
Pour into lined tin; cool 15 minutes until firm, then break into pieces.

recipes.title: Condensed Milk Fudge
steps: Grease a square tin and set it aside.
Put 1 can condensed-milk, 400 g white-sugar, 100 g butter, 200 ml fresh-milk, 1 pinch salt in pot.
Stir over low heat until sugar dissolves; boil 25 minutes, stirring constantly.
Drop a little into cold water to test for a soft ball.
Remove from heat; stir in 2 tsp vanilla-essence; beat 3 minutes until slightly thick.
Pour into tin; set 2 hours before cutting into blocks.

recipes.title: Hertzoggies
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C and grease a muffin tray.
Rub 80 g butter, 200 g cake-flour, 2 tsp baking-powder, 60 g white-sugar; mix 1 egg to soft-dough.
Press the dough into the muffin cups to make shallow tart cases.
Cream remaining 40 g butter, 120 g white-sugar, 1 egg; stir in 150 g desiccated-coconut topping.
Put 1 tsp apricot-jam per case; add coconut topping; bake 180 °C 20 min until golden.

recipes.title: Soetkoekies
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C and grease a baking tray.
Cream 200 g butter, 180 g white-sugar; beat in 2 tbsp golden-syrup.
Mix 1 tsp bicarbonate-of-soda into 2 tbsp warm water; add to butter mixture.
Stir 400 g cake-flour, 2 tsp ground-cinnamon, 1 pinch table-salt into soft dough.
Roll dough thinly, cut rounds; bake at 180 °C 12 minutes until pale gold.

recipes.title: Homemade Romany Creams
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C and grease two baking trays.
Melt 150 g butter with 2 tbsp golden-syrup; stir in 1 tsp bicarbonate-of-soda.
Mix 250 g cake-flour, 100 g desiccated-coconut, 40 g cocoa-powder, 120 g white-sugar; pour butter mixture for dough.
Roll into small balls; press flat on trays; bake 180 °C 12 minutes.
Melt 80 g chocolate-chips gently; sandwich cooled biscuits in pairs.

recipes.title: Chocolate Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C and line two 20 cm cake tins.
Cream 120 g butter with 250 g white-sugar; beat in 3 eggs, 2 tsp vanilla-essence.
Fold in 250 g cake-flour, 60 g cocoa-powder, 2 tsp baking-powder, 1 pinch table-salt, 200 ml fresh-milk.
Divide between tins; bake at 180 °C 30 minutes until skewer comes out clean.
Cool; beat remaining 40 g cocoa-powder into 200 g icing-sugar with water; ice and sandwich cakes.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C and line a 20 cm cake tin.
Beat 3 eggs with 200 g white-sugar and 180 ml cooking-oil until pale.
Fold 250 g cake-flour, 2 tsp baking-powder, 1 tsp bicarbonate-of-soda, 2 tsp ground-cinnamon into 300 g grated carrots.
Bake at 180 °C for 40 minutes until skewer comes out clean; cool completely.
Beat 150 g cream-cheese with 150 g icing-sugar; spread over cooled cake.

recipes.title: Banana Fritters
steps: Mash 4 bananas in a bowl.
Whisk 1 egg, 150 ml fresh-milk, banana; stir 150 g cake-flour, 2 tsp baking-powder to thick batter.
Heat 4 tbsp cooking-oil in pan; drop spoonfuls, fry 2 minutes per side until golden.
Drain on paper towel; toss with 3 tbsp white-sugar, 1 tsp ground-cinnamon.

recipes.title: Baked Custard
steps: Heat oven to 160 °C; place a roasting dish of hot water on bottom shelf.
Whisk 4 eggs, 100 g white-sugar, 2 tsp vanilla-essence; stir in 600 ml fresh-milk.
Strain the mixture into a baking dish and dust with 1 tsp ground cinnamon.
Bake in water bath at 160 °C for 30 minutes until just set, wobbly centre.
Cool slightly and serve warm or chilled.

recipes.title: Caramel Custard Pudding
steps: Heat the oven to 160 °C.
Melt 120 g white-sugar, 4-tbsp water in dry-pan on medium-heat until amber; pour into dish.
Whisk remaining 130 g white-sugar, 4 eggs, 2-tsp vanilla-essence; stir in 700 ml fresh-milk.
Pour custard over caramel; bake in water bath at 160 °C 40 minutes until set.
Cool 10 minutes; invert onto plate so caramel runs over pudding.

recipes.title: Chocolate Mousse
steps: Whip 250 ml fresh cream to soft peaks.
Fold in 200 g condensed milk and 1 tsp vanilla essence.
Sift in 40 g cocoa powder and fold gently until evenly blended.
Spoon into glasses and chill for at least 3 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Peppermint Crisp Baked Pudding
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C and grease a deep baking dish.
Cream 60 g butter with 100 g white-sugar; beat in 2 eggs.
Fold 150 g cake-flour, 2 tbsp cocoa-powder, 2 tsp baking-powder; loosen with 200 ml fresh-milk, spread in dish.
Mix remaining 50 g white-sugar, 2 tbsp cocoa-powder and 250 ml tap-water; pour gently over batter.
Bake 180 °C 30 minutes until sauce set; crush 2 peppermint-crisp bars over warm top.

recipes.title: Baked Vanilla Cheesecake
steps: Heat oven 160 °C; press crushed tennis-biscuits packet mixed with 100 g melted butter into springform-tin.
Beat 500 g cream-cheese with 180 g white-sugar until smooth; beat in 3 eggs one-by-one.
Stir in 150 g sour cream and 2 tsp vanilla essence until just combined.
Pour onto crust; bake 160 °C for 45 minutes until centre just set, slight wobble.
Cool completely, then chill for at least 3 hours before slicing.

recipes.title: Layered Trifle
steps: Dissolve 1 packet jelly-powder in 250 ml boiling water; add 250 ml cold water; chill until set.
Whisk 6 tbsp custard-powder, 3 tbsp white-sugar, 600 ml fresh-milk; heat 6 min until thick; cool.
Cut 4 white-bread slices into cubes and line the bottom of a glass bowl.
Layer set jelly and sliced bananas over bread; spoon cooled custard on top.
Whip 250 ml fresh cream to soft peaks and spread over the custard.
Chill for at least 2 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Apple Turnovers
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C and thaw 400 g frozen puff pastry.
Peel/core/dice 4 apples; cook in 20 g butter, 80 g white-sugar, 1 tsp ground-cinnamon 8 min till soft.
Cut pastry into 4 squares; spoon apple filling into each centre.
Fold into triangles and press the edges closed with a fork.
Bake at 200 °C for 20 min until puffed and golden; dust with 3 tbsp icing-sugar.

recipes.title: Baked Banana Pudding
steps: Heat oven to 180 °C; butter a baking dish with 10 g butter.
Slice 4 white bread slices and 3 bananas and layer them in the dish.
Beat 2 eggs, 400 ml fresh-milk, 80 g white-sugar, 1 tsp vanilla-essence; pour over bread and bananas.
Dot with the remaining 20 g butter and dust with 1 tsp ground cinnamon.
Bake at 180 °C for 30 minutes until set and golden.

recipes.title: Chocolate Steamed Pudding
steps: Grease a pudding basin and spoon 3 tbsp apricot jam into the bottom.
Cream 80 g butter with 120 g white sugar, then beat in 2 eggs.
Fold 150 g cake-flour, 40 g cocoa-powder, 2 tsp baking-powder with 100 ml fresh-milk.
Spoon the batter over the jam and cover the basin tightly with foil.
Set basin in pot with 1 l boiling water one-third; cover; steam gently 45 minutes.
Turn out onto a plate so the jam runs down over the pudding.

recipes.title: Chocolate Truffles
steps: Melt 200 g baking-chocolate with 30 g butter in a bowl over simmering water.
Stir in 150 g condensed milk until glossy and smooth.
Chill the mixture for 20 minutes until firm enough to roll.
Roll small balls; coat half in 60 g desiccated-coconut, leave rest plain.
Chill for at least 1 hour before serving.

recipes.title: Peppermint Crisp Ice Cream Cake
steps: Line loaf tin with cling wrap, then press tennis-biscuits in one layer.
Soften 1 l ice cream slightly and stir in 100 g condensed milk.
Crush 2 peppermint crisp bars and fold into the ice cream.
Spread half the ice cream over biscuits; add biscuit layer, then remaining ice cream.
Freeze for at least 4 hours, then turn out and slice.

recipes.title: Meringues
steps: Heat the oven to 110 °C and line a baking tray with baking paper.
Separate 4 eggs; whisk whites, adding 220 g white-sugar 1 tbsp at a time until stiff.
Fold in 1 tsp vinegar and 1 tsp corn flour.
Spoon or pipe mounds; bake at 110 °C for 50 minutes until crisp and dry.
Cool on the tray and store in an airtight tin.

recipes.title: Pavlova
steps: Heat the oven to 120 °C and line a baking tray with baking paper.
Whisk 4 egg-whites to soft-peaks; add 220 g white-sugar 1 tbsp at a time until stiff-glossy.
Fold in 2 tsp corn flour and 1 tsp vinegar.
Spread meringue into 20 cm circle with raised rim; bake at 120 °C 50 minutes.
Cool completely, then top with 250 ml whipped fresh cream and sliced bananas.
Finish with the segments and juice of 1 orange.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Rolls
steps: Mix 450 g cake-flour, 10 g instant-yeast, 40 g white-sugar, 1 pinch salt; rub in 40 g butter.
Warm 250 ml fresh-milk; mix to soft dough; knead 5 minutes; rest 15 minutes.
Roll the dough into a rectangle and spread with 40 g softened butter.
Mix remaining 50 g white-sugar, 2 tbsp ground-cinnamon; sprinkle, roll tightly, cut 8 rolls.
Place in greased dish; cover; rise 15 minutes; bake at 190 °C 25 minutes.
Mix 100 g icing-sugar with a little water and drizzle over the warm rolls.

recipes.title: Lemon Bars
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C and line a square tin.
Rub 150 g butter into 200 g cake-flour, 60 g icing-sugar; press into tin; bake 15 min.
Whisk 3 eggs, 200 g white-sugar, 3 lemons' juice and zest, 2 tbsp corn-flour.
Pour lemon mixture over hot base; bake 160 °C 20 minutes until just set.
Cool completely, then dust with icing sugar and cut into bars.

recipes.title: Biltong and Cheese Toastie
steps: Slice 2 bread rolls in half and butter the insides with 20 g butter.
Spread 1 tsp fruit-chutney on rolls; fill with 60 g biltong, 80 g cheddar-cheese.
Press rolls closed; toast in dry pan 2 minutes per side until cheese melts.
Cut each roll in half; press gently so cheddar holds biltong.

recipes.title: Mini Bread Pizzas
steps: Heat grill high; lightly toast 4 white-bread slices on one side.
Spread 1 tbsp tomato sauce on the untoasted side of each slice.
Top with 150 g grated mozzarella-cheese, 1 thinly sliced green-pepper and 1 tsp mixed-herbs.
Grill for 5 minutes until the cheese bubbles and browns.

recipes.title: Pita Chips with Tomato Dip
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C and cut 3 pita breads into wedges.
Toss wedges, 2 tbsp cooking-oil, 1 tsp paprika, 1-pinch table-salt; bake 200 °C 10 min crisp.
Chop 3 tomatoes, 1 onion, 1 garlic clove; mix 1 pinch table-salt for dip.
Serve the pita chips with the dip.

recipes.title: Hummus with Veg Sticks
steps: Drain 1 can chickpeas; blend 2 garlic-cloves, 1 lemon-juice, 1 tsp ground-cumin, 3 tbsp cooking-oil, 1 pinch table-salt.
Add 2 tbsp water gradually if hummus is too thick.
Cut 2 carrots and 1 cucumber into sticks and serve with the hummus.
Spoon hummus into bowl; swirl top with back of spoon.

recipes.title: Cucumber Yoghurt Dip with Crackers
steps: Grate 1 cucumber and squeeze out the excess water.
Mix cucumber into 300 g plain-yoghurt with 1 crushed garlic clove, 1 pinch table-salt.
Chop 1 handful fresh mint and stir it in.
Serve the dip with a packet of crackers.

recipes.title: Yoghurt, Banana and Honey Cup
steps: Spoon 300 g plain yoghurt into 2 cups.
Slice 1 banana over the yoghurt and sprinkle with 30 g rolled oats.
Drizzle 2 tsp honey over the top and serve.
Eat immediately, before the oats go soft.

recipes.title: Tuna Mayo Sandwich
steps: Drain 1 can tinned-tuna; mix with 3 tbsp mayonnaise and 1 pinch black-pepper.
Thinly slice 1 cucumber.
Spread tuna mayo on 2 wholewheat-bread slices; top cucumber; close with remaining slices.
Cut in half and serve, or wrap for a lunchbox.

recipes.title: Egg Mayonnaise Sandwich
steps: Boil 3 eggs for 9 minutes, then peel and mash them with a fork.
Stir 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 2 sliced spring onions, 1 pinch salt, 1 pinch black-pepper.
Spread egg mayonnaise over 2 white bread slices and close with remaining slices.
Trim the crusts if you like, then cut in half and serve.

recipes.title: Savoury Crackers with Cheese and Chutney
steps: Slice 120 g gouda cheese into thin squares.
Place a slice of cheese on each savoury cracker.
Top each with a small dollop of fruit chutney and serve immediately.
Arrange on a plate and serve as a snack board.

recipes.title: Cream Cheese and Cucumber Sandwich
steps: Spread 120 g cream cheese generously over 4 brown bread slices.
Thinly slice 1 cucumber and layer it over 2 of the slices.
Season with 1 pinch table-salt, 1 pinch black-pepper; close with remaining slices.
Press down lightly, cut into triangles and serve.

recipes.title: Amasi with brown bread and sugar
steps: Crumble 4 brown bread slices into two bowls.
Pour 300 ml amasi over the bread.
Sprinkle each with 1 tbsp white-sugar and 1 pinch ground-cinnamon; eat now.
Let it sit a minute so the bread soaks; eat with a spoon.

recipes.title: Mageu and banana breakfast cup
steps: Slice 2 bananas into two cups.
Pour 250 ml mageu over each cup.
Drizzle with 1 tbsp honey and dust with 1 pinch ground cinnamon.
Stir from the bottom and eat with a spoon.

recipes.title: Mielie bread
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C and grease a loaf tin.
Mix 250 g maize-meal, 100 g cake-flour, 3 tsp baking-powder, 2 tbsp white-sugar and 1 pinch table-salt.
Melt 60 g butter, then whisk it with 2 eggs and 300 ml buttermilk.
Fold wet into dry with 1 can sweetcorn, then pour into tin.
Bake at 180 °C for 40 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.

recipes.title: Vetkoek with syrup
steps: Halve 6 vetkoek; warm in dry pan 2 minutes per side.
Butter the cut sides with 30 g butter.
Drizzle 4 tbsp golden syrup over the hot vetkoek and serve immediately.
Eat while hot and sticky.

recipes.title: Boerewors breakfast roll
steps: Fry 400 g boerewors in 1 tbsp cooking-oil 12 minutes, turning until browned/cooked.
Slice the wors into lengths that fit the rolls.
Fry 4 eggs in the same pan.
Split 4 bread-rolls; fill each with wors, fried egg, 3 tbsp tomato-sauce.

recipes.title: Braai broodjie
steps: Butter 8 white bread slices on one side with 40 g butter.
Slice 2 tomatoes, 1 onion and 150 g cheddar cheese thinly.
Make 4 sandwiches with cheddar-cheese, tomatoes, onions, 3 tbsp fruit-chutney; buttered sides out.
Toast over medium coals/dry pan 3 minutes per side; golden, cheese melts.

recipes.title: Leftover roast chicken breakfast hash
steps: Dice 4 potatoes and boil them for 8 minutes, then drain.
Shred 400 g cooked chicken thigh meat off the bone.
Fry 1 onion 2 tbsp cooking-oil 3 minutes; add potatoes, chicken, 1 tsp paprika.
Fry 8 minutes until golden; season with 1 pinch table-salt and 1 pinch black-pepper.
Make 4 wells, crack 1 egg into each, cover; cook 5 minutes until set.

recipes.title: Sweet potato and egg breakfast hash
steps: Peel and dice 4 sweet potatoes and boil them for 8 minutes, then drain.
Fry 1 chopped onion in 2 tbsp cooking oil for 3 minutes.
Add sweet-potato and 1 tsp paprika; fry 8 minutes until golden, season 1 pinch table-salt.
Make 4 wells; crack 1 egg each, cover, cook 5 minutes until just set.

recipes.title: Breakfast wrap with egg and polony
steps: Slice 150 g polony and fry in 1 tbsp cooking-oil for 3 minutes.
Scramble 4 eggs in the same pan for 3 minutes until just set.
Warm 4 tortillas in a dry pan for 20 seconds each.
Fill tortillas with egg, polony, 100 g cheddar-cheese and tomato-sauce; roll up.

recipes.title: Corn fritters with tomato relish
steps: Mix 2 cans sweetcorn, 2 eggs, 150 g cake-flour, 1 tsp baking-powder, 3 spring-onions, 1 pinch salt.
Heat 4 tbsp cooking-oil; fry batter spoonfuls 3 minutes per side until golden.
Chop 3 tomatoes, 1 onion; mix 1 tbsp vinegar, 1 pinch salt into relish.
Serve the hot fritters with the tomato relish.

recipes.title: Yeast spread toast with soft-boiled egg
steps: Lower 4 eggs into boiling water; cook 5 minutes, cool briefly in cold water.
Toast 4 wholewheat-bread slices; spread 20 g butter and 2 tbsp yeast spread.
Cut the tops off the eggs and serve alongside the toast for dipping.
Dip the toast soldiers into the runny yolks and eat while warm.

recipes.title: Amasi, honey and sultana cup
steps: Divide 400 ml amasi between two cups.
Stir 60 g sultanas through amasi and drizzle each cup with 1 tbsp honey.
Finish with 1 pinch ground cinnamon.
Let the sultanas soak for 5 minutes before eating so they plump up.

recipes.title: Wholewheat and raisin muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C and line a 6-cup muffin tray.
Mix 250 g wholewheat-flour, 100 g sultanas, 80 g white-sugar, 3 tsp baking-powder, 1 pinch table-salt.
Whisk 2 eggs, 250 ml fresh-milk, 80 ml cooking-oil; fold into dry mix until just combined.
Spoon into muffin cups; bake 200 °C 18 minutes until risen and golden.

recipes.title: Apple and cinnamon muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C and line a 6-cup muffin tray.
Peel and dice 2 apples.
Mix 250 g cake-flour, 100 g white-sugar, 2 tsp ground-cinnamon, 3 tsp baking-powder; fold apple.
Whisk 2 eggs, 200 ml fresh-milk, 80 ml cooking-oil; fold into dry mix, spoon into cups.
Bake at 200 °C for 18 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.

recipes.title: Cheese and herb muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C and line a 6-cup muffin tray.
Mix 250 g cake-flour, 3 tsp baking-powder, 2 tsp mixed-herbs, 1 pinch table-salt.
Whisk 2 eggs, 250 ml fresh-milk, 80 ml cooking-oil; fold in dry mix and 120 g cheddar-cheese.
Spoon into cups; scatter remaining 30 g cheddar-cheese; bake at 200 °C 18 minutes.

recipes.title: Egg and cheese breakfast muffin
steps: Split 4 bread-rolls; toast cut sides in 20 g butter 1 minute.
Fry 4 eggs in pan, keeping yolks soft; season 1 pinch black-pepper.
Place an egg on each roll bottom; top with 100 g cheddar; close rolls.
Return to the pan for 1 minute so the cheese melts.

recipes.title: Amasi and apple breakfast bowl
steps: Core and grate 2 apples without peeling them.
Divide 400 ml amasi between two bowls and top with the grated apple.
Drizzle each bowl with 1 tbsp honey and dust with 1 tsp ground cinnamon.
Stir the apple through the amasi so every spoonful has fruit.

recipes.title: Breakfast rice bowl with egg
steps: Boil 150 g white rice in 300 ml water for 15 minutes.
Heat 1 tbsp cooking-oil; fry 4 eggs 2 minutes until whites set.
Divide the rice between two bowls and top each with 2 fried eggs.
Drizzle 2 tbsp soy-sauce, 1 tsp sesame-oil; scatter 3 sliced spring-onions.

recipes.title: Boerewors and egg breakfast bowl with tomato relish
steps: Fry 400 g boerewors in 1 tbsp cooking-oil 12 minutes, turning; slice into rounds.
Fry 4 eggs in the same pan.
Chop 3 tomatoes, 1 onion; mix with 1 tbsp vinegar, 1 pinch table-salt.
Divide the wors and eggs between four bowls and spoon the tomato relish alongside.

recipes.title: Cold pasta salad with tuna and sweetcorn
steps: Boil 250 g macaroni for 10 minutes, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Drain 1 can tuna and 1 can sweetcorn.
Dice 2 tomatoes and 1 cucumber.
Mix 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tbsp vinegar, 1 pinch salt, 1 pinch black-pepper; toss everything, chill.

recipes.title: Chicken mayo sandwich
steps: Boil 200 g chicken-breasts in salted water 12 minutes, then shred with two forks.
Mix shredded chicken with 3 tbsp mayonnaise and 1 pinch black-pepper; cool completely.
Spread chicken mayonnaise on 2 wholewheat-bread slices; add 4 lettuce leaves, close with rest.
Cut diagonally and wrap the second half for later.

recipes.title: Four-bean salad with onion vinaigrette
steps: Drain and rinse 2 cans four-bean mix.
Finely chop 1 onion and 1 green pepper.
Whisk 3 tbsp vinegar, 3 tbsp cooking-oil, 1 tsp white-sugar, 1 pinch each salt/black-pepper.
Toss everything and chill at least 15 minutes before packing into lunch boxes.

recipes.title: Chickpea and tomato salad
steps: Drain and rinse 2 cans chickpeas.
Dice 4 tomatoes and 1 cucumber and finely chop 1 onion.
Whisk juice of 1 lemon with 3 tbsp cooking-oil and 1 pinch table-salt.
Toss chickpeas and vegetables with dressing, 1 handful chopped parsley; chill.

recipes.title: Lentil salad with feta
steps: Drain and rinse 2 cans tinned lentils.
Dice 3 tomatoes and 1 cucumber and finely chop 1 onion.
Whisk juice of 1 lemon with 3 tbsp cooking-oil and 1 pinch table-salt.
Toss lentils and vegetables with dressing; crumble 100 g feta; scatter 1 handful mint.

recipes.title: Baked potato with cheese and beans
steps: Heat oven to 200 °C and prick 2 large potatoes all over with fork.
Bake at 200 °C for 50 minutes until a knife slides in easily.
Warm 1 can baked-beans in pot for 5 minutes; season with 1 pinch black-pepper.
Split potatoes; fluff insides with 20 g butter, spoon beans over, top 80 g grated cheddar-cheese.

recipes.title: Vetkoek with curried beans
steps: Fry 1 chopped onion in 1 tbsp cooking oil for 3 minutes.
Stir in 1 tsp curry-powder, 2 chopped tomatoes; cook 4 minutes.
Add 2 cans baked beans and 1 pinch salt and simmer for 6 minutes.
Warm 8 vetkoek, split them open and fill with the curried beans.

recipes.title: Leftover roast chicken and gravy pap bowl
steps: Boil 500 ml water and 1 pinch salt; whisk in 150 g maize-meal; simmer 15 min, stirring.
Shred 250 g leftover cooked chicken thigh meat off the bone.
Fry 1 onion in 1 tbsp cooking-oil 3 min; add 1 tbsp cake-flour, 100 ml water, 1 stock-cube.
Add shredded chicken; simmer 5 minutes to make gravy; spoon over pap.

recipes.title: Beef and chakalaka lunch bowl
steps: Boil 150 g white rice in 400 ml of the water for 15 minutes.
Slice 250 g leftover cooked beef into strips and 1 onion.
Fry onion 1 tbsp cooking-oil 3 min; add beef, 1 can chakalaka, 100 ml water, 1 pinch table-salt.
Simmer for 5 minutes, then spoon over the rice in two lunch bowls.

recipes.title: Halloumi and tomato sandwich
steps: Slice 150 g halloumi-cheese and fry in 1 tsp cooking-oil, 2 minutes per side until golden.
Slice 2 tomatoes and split 2 bread rolls.
Fill each roll with halloumi, tomato, 2 lettuce leaves and 1 pinch black pepper.
Press the rolls closed so the warm halloumi softens into the tomato.

recipes.title: Beetroot and feta salad
steps: Boil 4 beetroot for 40 minutes until tender, then peel and slice them.
Tear 1 lettuce into a bowl and thinly slice 1 onion.
Whisk 2 tbsp vinegar, 3 tbsp cooking-oil, 1 pinch table-salt, 1 pinch black-pepper.
Toss beetroot and onion with dressing; crumble 100 g feta-cheese over.

recipes.title: Potato salad with egg
steps: Boil 4 peeled potatoes for 15 minutes until soft, then cool and cube them.
Boil 3 eggs for 8 minutes, peel and chop them.
Mix 3-tbsp mayonnaise, 1-tbsp vinegar, 1-tsp mustard, 1-pinch table-salt, 1-pinch black-pepper.
Toss the potatoes and egg with the dressing and 3 sliced spring onions.

recipes.title: Creamy tomato soup in a flask
steps: Fry 1 chopped onion, 3 crushed garlic cloves in 20 g butter 4 minutes.
Add 8 tomatoes, 2 tbsp tomato-paste, 2 stock-cubes, 500 ml water, 1 pinch table-salt; simmer 15 minutes.
Blend smooth; stir in 200 ml fresh-milk; heat through without boiling.
Pour into flasks for lunch.

recipes.title: Beef and mustard sandwich
steps: Slice 200 g leftover cooked beef thinly and season with 1 pinch black pepper.
Spread 2 tsp mustard over 4 brown bread slices.
Layer beef, 60 g sliced cheddar-cheese, 1 sliced tomato on 2 slices; close with rest.
Cut in half and serve with a crack of black pepper on top.

recipes.title: Egg and tomato lunch wrap
steps: Boil 3 eggs for 9 minutes, then peel and slice them.
Slice 2 tomatoes and wash 4 lettuce leaves.
Spread 1 tbsp mayonnaise over each of 2 tortillas.
Fill with egg, tomato, lettuce; season 1 pinch table-salt; roll up tightly.

recipes.title: Avocado and egg toast
steps: Toast 4 wholewheat bread slices until golden.
Mash 1 avocado with juice of 1 lemon, 1 pinch table-salt, 1 pinch black-pepper.
Fry 2 eggs in a non-stick pan for 2 minutes.
Spread the avocado over the toast and top each pair with a fried egg.

recipes.title: Cold instant noodle salad
steps: Boil 500 ml water; cook 2 packets instant-noodles 3 minutes; drain, rinse cold.
Julienne 1 cucumber and 1 carrot.
Whisk 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil and 1 tbsp vinegar.
Toss cold noodles with vegetables and dressing; scatter 40 g peanuts.

recipes.title: Pita pocket with hummus and veg
steps: Blend 1-can drained chickpeas, 1-garlic clove, 1-lemon juice, 3-tbsp cooking-oil, 1-pinch table-salt until smooth.
Julienne 1 cucumber and 1 carrot.
Warm 2 pita breads and split them open.
Fill each with the hummus, cucumber, carrot and 2 lettuce leaves.

recipes.title: Sardines on crackers
steps: Open 1 can sardines in tomato sauce and flake the fish with a fork.
Finely chop 1 onion and stir it in with 1 pinch black pepper.
Spoon the sardine mixture onto crackers from a packet.
Finish each cracker with a squeeze of 1 lemon.

recipes.title: Chickpea and tuna salad
steps: Drain 1 can chickpeas and 1 can tuna.
Dice 2 tomatoes and 1 cucumber and finely chop 1 onion.
Whisk juice of 1 lemon with 2 tbsp cooking-oil and 1 pinch black-pepper.
Toss everything together and pack into lunch boxes.

recipes.title: Creamed spinach on toast
steps: Fry 1 chopped onion, 1 crushed garlic clove in 20 g butter 3 minutes.
Add 300 g frozen chopped spinach and cook for 6 minutes until wilted.
Stir in 80 g cream cheese, 1 pinch salt and 1 pinch black pepper.
Toast 4 wholewheat bread slices and spoon the creamed spinach over them.

recipes.title: Butternut and feta salad
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C and cut 600 g butternut into cubes.
Toss with 2-tbsp cooking-oil, 1-pinch table-salt, 1-pinch black-pepper; roast 200 °C 25 minutes until tender.
Whisk 2 tbsp vinegar and 1 tbsp honey into a dressing.
Toss 1 lettuce, 1 onion with dressing; top with butternut; crumble 100 g feta-cheese.

recipes.title: Coleslaw with polony
steps: Shred 400 g cabbage finely and grate 2 carrots.
Cut 200 g polony into thin strips.
Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tbsp vinegar, 1 tsp white-sugar, 1 pinch black-pepper into dressing.
Toss everything together and chill before packing into lunch boxes.

recipes.title: Egg salad with crackers
steps: Boil 4 eggs for 9 minutes, then peel and chop them.
Stir 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tsp mustard, 2 spring-onions, 1 pinch each salt, black-pepper.
Pack egg salad into a tub and serve with a packet of crackers.
Keep the egg salad chilled until you eat it.

recipes.title: Chicken liver pate on toast
steps: Fry 2 chopped onions, 2 crushed garlic in 30 g butter 4 min.
Add 400 g trimmed chicken livers and fry for 6 minutes until cooked through.
Blend livers, 100 g cream-cheese, 1 tsp mixed-herbs, 1 pinch table-salt, 1 pinch black-pepper.
Chill pate 10 min; toast 8 white-bread slices; spread remaining 30 g butter.
Serve the pate on the warm toast.

recipes.title: Corned Beef and Cabbage Stew
steps: Fry 1 onion, 2 garlic clove in 1 tbsp cooking-oil 4 minutes until soft.
Add 1 can corned-beef, break into chunks; fry 3 minutes to brown edges.
Add 600 ml water, 1 stock-cube, 1 pinch salt, 1 pinch black-pepper; simmer 8 minutes.
Add 4 quartered potatoes and simmer for 15 minutes until almost tender.
Add 500 g shredded cabbage; cook 10 minutes until soft but bright; serve with broth.

recipes.title: Tinned Mackerel and Tomato Pasta
steps: Boil 300 g penne in salted water 10 minutes; drain, keep 2 tbsp pasta water.
While it cooks, fry 1 onion, 3 garlic cloves in 2 tbsp cooking-oil 4 minutes.
Stir 0.5 tsp chilli-powder, 1 tbsp tomato-paste; add 3 tomatoes, cook 6 minutes until saucy.
Drain 2 cans tinned-mackerel-tomato; flake into pan, discard bones, add pasta water, simmer 4 min.
Season 1 pinch table-salt, 1 pinch black-pepper; toss penne through sauce, serve from pan.

recipes.title: Chicken Giblets and Samp Stew
steps: Rinse 250 g samp; boil 1.2 l tap-water 45 min until grains split, topping up.
Meanwhile rinse 500 g chicken-giblets; halve large pieces; brown in 1 tbsp cooking-oil 6 min.
Add 1 chopped onion, 2 crushed garlic, 2 chopped carrots; fry 4 min.
Stir 2 stock-cubes, 1 pinch table-salt, 1 pinch black-pepper; add 300 ml water; scrape pan.
Tip giblet mixture into samp pot; simmer 20 min until samp soft and liquid thickened.

recipes.title: Vienna Sausage and Potato Stew
steps: Fry 1 onion in 1 tbsp cooking-oil 4 minutes; add 1 tsp curry-powder, cook 30 seconds.
Add 4 potatoes, 400 ml water, 1 stock-cube, 1 pinch table-salt; simmer 15 minutes until nearly soft.
Slice 1 can vienna sausages into rounds and add them with 2 chopped tomatoes.
Simmer 8 min till potatoes tender, sauce thick; avoid hard boil, sausages split.

recipes.title: Chicken and Peanut Butter Stew
steps: Brown 600 g chicken-thighs whole in 2 tbsp cooking-oil 6 minutes; lift out.
Fry 2 onions, 2 garlic 3 min; add 3 tomatoes, 1 tsp curry-powder; cook 5 min.
Return chicken with 500 ml tap-water, 2 stock-cubes, 1 pinch table-salt; cover; simmer 20 min.
Spoon a ladle hot sauce into 120 g peanut-butter; stir smooth; return to pot.
Simmer uncovered 8 min until sauce coats chicken; scatter 1 handful coriander.

recipes.title: Samp and Mutton Stew
steps: Rinse 250 g samp; boil in 1.2 l water 45 minutes until soft, topping up.
Brown 600 g mutton-stewing-pieces in 2 tbsp cooking-oil 7 minutes until coloured.
Add 2 onions, 2 garlic cloves, 3 carrots; fry 4 minutes.
Add 2 stock-cubes, 1 pinch salt, 1 pinch black-pepper, 300 ml water; cover, simmer 30 minutes.
Tip mutton and gravy into samp; simmer 15 minutes so samp absorbs juices.

recipes.title: Dry-Fried Cabbage and Soya Chunks
steps: Boil 300 g white-rice in 600 ml tap-water 15 minutes; keep warm.
Soak 200 g soya-chunks in 200 ml hot water 5 minutes; drain, squeeze dry.
Heat 2 tbsp cooking-oil; dry-fry soya-chunks 5 minutes until edges brown.
Add 1 chopped onion, 3 crushed garlic, 2 grated carrots; stir-fry 3 minutes.
Add 400 g shredded cabbage; stir-fry 6 minutes until wilted but crisp.
Add 3 tbsp soy-sauce, 1 pinch black-pepper; toss 1 minute, serve over rice.

recipes.title: Beef and Beetroot Stew
steps: Brown 500 g beef stewing pieces in 2 tbsp cooking oil for 7 minutes.
Add 2 chopped onions and 2 crushed garlic cloves and fry for 4 minutes.
Add 800 ml water, 2 stock-cubes, 1 pinch table-salt, 1 pinch black-pepper; simmer covered 35 min.
Peel and chunk 4 beetroot and 3 potatoes; add both to pot.
Simmer uncovered 25 min until beetroot tender, liquid deep red thick; stir twice, preserve shape.

recipes.title: Tinned Sardine and Spinach Pasta
steps: Boil 300 g spaghetti in salted water 10 minutes; drain, keep 3 tbsp cooking water.
Fry 1 onion, 3 garlic cloves in 2 tbsp cooking-oil 4 minutes.
Add 0.5 tsp chilli-powder, 300 g frozen-chopped-spinach; cook 6 minutes until wilted, water cooked off.
Add 2 cans tinned-sardines-tomato, break fish with spoon; simmer 4 minutes.
Loosen with pasta water; season 1 pinch table-salt, 1 pinch black-pepper; toss spaghetti, serve.

recipes.title: Pumpkin and Samp Vegetarian Stew
steps: Rinse 200 g samp; boil in 1.2 l water 35 minutes until softening.
Fry 1 chopped onion, 2 crushed garlic, 1 tbsp cooking-oil 4 min; add 1 tsp curry-powder.
Add 3 chopped tomatoes, 2 stock-cubes, 1 pinch table-salt; cook 5 minutes until saucy.
Add tomato mixture and 700 g peeled cubed pumpkin to samp pot.
Simmer 15 minutes until pumpkin holds shape, samp creamy; stir gently once or twice.
Scatter with 1 handful chopped coriander before serving.

recipes.title: Golden Hake Fish Cakes
steps: Cube 400 g potatoes, boil salted water 12 min, drain, mash dry.
Steam 400 g hake with splash water, cover, 7 min till flaky, debone.
Tear 2 slice white-bread to crumbs, chop 1 handful parsley.
Mix fish, mash, crumbs, parsley, 2 eggs, 1 pinch salt, 1 pinch pepper.
Shape 8 cakes, fry in 3 tbsp oil 4 min per side till gold.

recipes.title: Everyday Lentil Curry
steps: Wash 250 g red lentils till water clears, drain.
Fry 1 chopped onion, 2 clove garlic in 2 tbsp oil 5 min.
Add 2 tbsp curry powder, fry 30 sec, add 3 tomatoes, cook 3 min.
Add lentils, 600 ml water, 1 pinch salt, boil, simmer covered 25 min.
Stir in 1 can coconut milk, simmer 5 min uncovered, serve.

recipes.title: Kidney Bean Chilli with Rice
steps: Boil 300 g white rice in 600 ml water 15 min.
Fry 1 onion, 3 clove garlic, 1 green pepper, 2 tbsp oil 4 min.
Add 1 tsp chilli, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika, fry 1 min.
Add 2 tbsp tomato paste, 4 tomatoes, 2 can beans, simmer 15 min.
Serve chilli over rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Drumsticks with Pap and Tomato Gravy
steps: Boil 900 ml tap-water, 1 pinch table-salt; whisk 250 g maize-meal; simmer 15 min.
Brown 1000 g chicken drumsticks in 2 tbsp oil 8 min.
Add 2 onion, 2 clove garlic, fry 3 min.
Add 4 tomatoes, 1 tbsp tomato paste, 300 ml water, simmer covered 15 min.
Serve drumsticks and gravy over pap.

recipes.title: Chicken Schnitzel with Potato Wedges
steps: Heat oven 200 °C, cut 6 potatoes wedges, roast in 1 tbsp oil 30 min.
Slice 600 g chicken breasts to cutlets, season 1 pinch salt, 1 pinch pepper.
Set 100 g flour, 2 beaten eggs, 150 g breadcrumbs in bowls.
Coat cutlets flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry schnitzels in 3 tbsp oil 3 min per side till gold.
Boil 200 g peas 4 min, serve with wedges, 1 lemon squeeze.

recipes.title: Durban Fish Curry
steps: Fry 2 onion, 3 clove garlic, 1 tsp ginger, 2 tbsp oil till soft.
Add 2 tbsp curry, 1 tsp turmeric, fry 1 min.
Add 3 tomatoes, 1 pinch salt, simmer 8 min till thick.
Add 2 tbsp tamarind, 200 ml water, 600 g hake, cover.
Simmer 10 min till fish flakes, scatter 1 handful coriander.

recipes.title: Vegetable and Chickpea Tagine
steps: Fry 1 onion, 3 clove garlic in 2 tbsp oil 3 min.
Add 1 tsp cinnamon, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika, fry 1 min.
Add 3 tomatoes, 500 g butternut, 2 carrots, 1 can chickpeas, 50 g apricots.
Add 300 ml water, 1 pinch salt, cover, simmer 30 min.
Cook till veg tender and sauce thick, serve.

recipes.title: Marie Biscuit Chocolate Fridge Cake
steps: Melt 150 g butter in pot low heat.
Whisk 4 tbsp cocoa, 150 g icing sugar, 1 egg, 1 tsp vanilla.
Cook 2 min till glossy, then cool 5 min.
Break 1 unit marie biscuits, fold into mix.
Press into lined tin, chill 3 hours, slice.

recipes.title: Caramel Marie Biscuit Fridge Tart
steps: Melt 100 g butter, 1 can condensed milk, 2 tbsp syrup 8 min.
Line loaf tin with layer marie biscuits.
Pour third caramel over biscuits, add biscuit layer.
Repeat till caramel and biscuits used, finish caramel top.
Chill 3 hours, whip 200 ml cream, top, slice.

recipes.title: Rice and beans lunch bowl
steps: Boil 150 g rice in 300 ml water 15 min.
Fry 1 onion, 2 clove garlic in 1 tbsp oil 3 min.
Add 1 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tsp cumin, 1 pinch salt, fry 1 min.
Add 1 can beans, heat 5 min.
Spoon beans over rice, serve bowls.

recipes.title: Roosterkoek with Braai Spice
steps: Mix flour, yeast, sugar, salt and braai spice thoroughly.
Add warm water and oil, knead 8 minutes until smooth.
Cover dough, prove 45 minutes until double size.
Divide into 8 balls, flatten slightly, rest 10 minutes.
Braai over medium coals 10 minutes per side until cooked.

recipes.title: Peanut Spinach Morogo-Style
steps: Fry chopped onion and garlic in oil for 3 minutes.
Add chopped tomatoes, cook 4 minutes until soft.
Stir in peanut butter and 100 ml water to melt.
Add chopped spinach, salt, simmer 6 minutes until wilted.
Season with pepper and serve with pap or rice.

recipes.title: Ox Liver with Atchar and Onion
steps: Slice liver into strips, season with salt and curry powder.
Heat oil, fry sliced onions and garlic 4 minutes until golden.
Add liver strips, sear 3 minutes per side until browned.
Add atchar and water, simmer 6 minutes until tender.
Serve hot with pap, rice or brown bread.

recipes.title: Peri-Peri Giblets Braise
steps: Clean giblets, cut larger pieces, rinse and drain.
Heat oil, fry onion and garlic 3 minutes until soft.
Add giblets, brown 5 minutes stirring constantly.
Add chopped tomatoes, peri-peri sauce, water and salt.
Cover, simmer 25 minutes until giblets are tender, serve.

recipes.title: Three-Bean Atchar Potjie
steps: Soak sugar beans overnight, drain and rinse thoroughly.
Heat oil in potjie, fry onion and garlic 4 minutes.
Add curry powder, chopped tomatoes, atchar, stir 2 minutes.
Add soaked beans, stock cube and water, simmer 60 minutes.
Add butter beans and baked beans, cook 15 minutes, serve.

recipes.title: Red Lentil and Spinach Soup
steps: Heat oil, fry onion, garlic, diced carrots 4 minutes.
Add curry powder, diced potatoes, lentils, stir 1 minute.
Add water, stock cube, salt, bring to boil.
Simmer 20 minutes until lentils and potatoes soften.
Stir in chopped spinach, cook 5 minutes, serve hot.

recipes.title: Cabbage and Soya Lunch Wraps
steps: Soak soya chunks in 200 ml hot water 10 minutes, drain.
Heat oil, stir-fry soya and shredded cabbage 4 minutes.
Add grated carrot, salt, tomato sauce, cook 2 minutes.
Warm tortillas, spread mayonnaise inside each wrap.
Fill with cabbage soya mix, roll tightly, pack for lunchbox.

recipes.title: Soya Chunks Cabbage Curry with Rice
steps: Soak soya chunks in 300 ml hot water 10 minutes, drain.
Cook rice in 600 ml water with pinch salt 18 minutes.
Heat oil, fry onion and garlic 3 minutes until soft.
Add curry powder, tomatoes, cabbage, soya, salt, 200 ml water.
Simmer 15 minutes until cabbage tender, serve over rice.

recipes.title: Braaied Hake with Apricot Chakalaka Glaze
steps: Mix apricot jam, chakalaka, oil, crushed garlic, lemon juice.
Season hake with salt and pepper, brush with glaze.
Place fish on oiled braai grid over medium coals.
Braai 6 minutes per side, basting with remaining glaze.
Serve with roosterkoek or pap and lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Ting-Inspired Sour Porridge with Amasi
steps: Mix 100 g maize meal with amasi, ferment overnight 12 hours.
Bring water and salt to rolling boil in pot.
Whisk in remaining maize meal, stir to avoid lumps.
Add fermented mix, simmer 15 minutes stirring often.
Heat oil, wilt spinach 2 minutes, stir into porridge.
Sweeten with sugar, serve warm with extra amasi.

recipes.title: Chicken Livers and Spinach with Samp
steps: Rinse samp, soak overnight, then boil 40 minutes until tender.
Heat oil, fry onion and garlic 3 minutes until soft.
Add chicken livers, curry powder, brown 4 minutes.
Add chopped tomatoes, 100 ml water, simmer 8 minutes.
Stir in spinach and cooked samp, cook 5 minutes, serve.

recipes.title: Atchar Bean Kota
steps: Slice rolls open, hollow slightly, toast inside lightly.
Heat oil, fry polony slices 3 minutes until golden.
Warm baked beans with tomato sauce 2 minutes.
Fill rolls with beans, polony, atchar and grated cheese.
Close kota, press gently, serve hot or pack.

recipes.title: Creamy Butternut and Peanut Soup
steps: Heat oil, fry onion, garlic, diced carrot 4 minutes.
Add cubed butternut, stir 2 minutes to coat.
Add water, stock cube, salt, boil then simmer 25 minutes.
Stir in peanut butter until melted and creamy.
Blend half soup, return to pot, season with pepper.

recipes.title: Cape Malay Soya Bobotie
steps: Soak soya mince in 300 ml hot water 10 minutes, drain.
Soak bread in 100 ml milk, mash to paste.
Heat oil, fry onion and garlic 3 minutes, add curry.
Add soya, apricot jam, vinegar, bread paste, salt, cook 8 minutes.
Transfer to dish, whisk eggs with remaining milk, pour over.
Bake 25 minutes at 180 °C until custard sets, serve with rice.

recipes.title: Durban Chickpea and Cabbage Curry
steps: Heat oil, fry onion and garlic 3 minutes until golden.
Add curry powder, turmeric, stir 1 minute until fragrant.
Add diced potatoes, shredded cabbage, cook 5 minutes.
Add chopped tomatoes, chickpeas with liquid, salt, simmer 18 minutes.
Serve hot with roti, rice or roosterkoek.

recipes.title: Savoury Oats with Tomato and Egg
steps: Heat oil, fry chopped onion 3 minutes until soft.
Add chopped tomatoes, salt, cook 4 minutes until pulpy.
Add oats and water, simmer 5 minutes stirring often.
Crack eggs on top, cover 3 minutes until eggs set.
Season with pepper, serve hot for breakfast.

recipes.title: Tinned Mackerel and Atchar Fried Rice
steps: Cook rice in 400 ml water 15 minutes, cool slightly.
Heat oil, fry onion and garlic 3 minutes.
Add mackerel with sauce, break into chunks, fry 2 minutes.
Add cold rice, atchar, soy sauce, toss 3 minutes.
Push aside, scramble eggs in pan, mix through rice.

recipes.title: Spinach and Peanut Butter Dombolo
steps: Chop spinach finely, wilt in pan 2 minutes, cool.
Mix flour and salt, add spinach, peanut butter, milk, oil.
Knead lightly into soft dough, form 4 balls.
Place in greased bowl, cover with lid or foil.
Steam over boiling water 45 minutes until cooked through.

recipes.title: Braaied Boerewors and Sweetcorn Braai Broodjie
steps: Braai boerewors 8 minutes until cooked, slice thinly.
Butter bread slices outside, spread tomato sauce inside.
Fill with wors slices, drained sweetcorn, grated cheese.
Close sandwiches, press gently to seal edges.
Braai on grid 3 minutes per side until golden.

recipes.title: Amasi and Banana Lunchbox Cup with Oats
steps: Slice bananas, divide between 2 lunch cups.
Mix amasi, peanut butter, honey until smooth.
Pour amasi mix over bananas, stir gently.
Sprinkle rolled oats and cinnamon on top.
Chill until lunch, stir before eating.

recipes.title: Samp and Peanut Stew
steps: Rinse samp, soak overnight, drain and rinse.
Heat oil, fry onion and garlic 3 minutes until soft.
Add curry powder, chopped tomatoes, cook 4 minutes.
Add samp, stock cube, water, salt, bring to boil.
Simmer 60 minutes until samp tender, stir often.
Stir in peanut butter until creamy, serve hot.

recipes.title: Curried Cabbage, Peas and Rice
steps: Cook rice in 500 ml water 15 minutes, keep warm.
Heat oil, fry onion and garlic 3 minutes until golden.
Add curry powder, chopped tomatoes, cook 3 minutes.
Add shredded cabbage, peas, 200 ml water, salt.
Simmer 12 minutes until cabbage tender, serve over rice.

recipes.title: Boerewors in Tomato and Onion Gravy
steps: Cut wors into pieces, fry in oil 5 minutes until browned.
Remove wors, fry sliced onions and garlic 4 minutes.
Add chopped tomatoes, tomato paste, stock cube, water.
Return wors, add salt, simmer 15 minutes until gravy thickens.
Serve hot with pap, rice or roosterkoek.

recipes.title: Pilchard and Spinach Baked Potatoes
steps: Bake potatoes 40 minutes until soft, or boil 25 minutes.
Heat oil, fry chopped onion 3 minutes until soft.
Add pilchards with sauce, break into flakes, heat 3 minutes.
Add thawed spinach, salt, pepper, cook 3 minutes.
Split potatoes, fill with pilchard spinach mix, top cheese.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato and Sugar Bean Stew
steps: Heat oil, fry onion and garlic 3 minutes until soft.
Add curry powder, chopped tomatoes, cook 3 minutes.
Add cubed sweet potato, drained beans, water, salt.
Simmer 25 minutes until sweet potato tender.
Stir in spinach, cook 3 minutes until wilted, serve.

recipes.title: Cheesy Polony and Tomato Macaroni
steps: Boil water, cook macaroni 10 minutes until tender, drain.
Heat oil, fry onion and garlic 3 minutes until soft.
Add diced polony, fry 3 minutes until lightly browned.
Add chopped tomatoes, salt, simmer 6 minutes until saucy.
Toss in macaroni, grated cheese, stir until cheese melts.

recipes.title: Vetkoek with Curried Cabbage
steps: Heat oil, fry onion 3 minutes until soft and translucent.
Add curry powder, grated carrot, shredded cabbage, salt.
Add chopped tomatoes, 100 ml water, simmer 15 minutes.
Slice vetkoek open, or fry store vetkoek 2 minutes per side.
Fill vetkoek with curried cabbage, serve hot.

recipes.title: No-Cook Tuna and Sweetcorn Wraps
steps: Drain tuna and sweetcorn, mix in bowl with mayonnaise.
Chop tomato, shred lettuce, add to tuna mix.
Season with pepper, stir gently to combine.
Warm tortillas 30 seconds, spoon filling down centre.
Roll tightly, cut in half, pack for lunchbox.

recipes.title: Mielie Rice with Chakalaka and Fried Egg
steps: Cook rice in 300 ml salted water 15 minutes until fluffy.
Heat oil, fry sliced onion 3 minutes until golden.
Add chakalaka tin, heat 3 minutes until bubbling.
Stir in cooked rice, toss 2 minutes to coat evenly.
Fry eggs 3 minutes, serve on top of mielie chakalaka rice.

recipes.title: Amasi Oats with Peanut, Honey and Sultanas
steps: Mix oats, amasi, peanut butter, milk in bowl, rest 5 minutes.
Add sultanas, stir, let soak 2 minutes to soften.
Slice banana, fold half into oats mixture gently.
Drizzle honey over top, stir lightly to swirl.
Top with remaining banana, serve immediately or chill.

recipes.title: Soya Mince and Spinach Pasta
steps: Soak soya mince in 250 ml hot water 10 minutes, drain.
Cook macaroni 10 minutes until tender, drain and keep.
Heat oil, fry onion and garlic 3 minutes until soft.
Add soya, curry powder, tomatoes, salt, simmer 8 minutes.
Stir in spinach and macaroni, cook 3 minutes, serve.

recipes.title: Chakalaka and Sweet Potato Lunch Bowl
steps: Peel sweet potato, cube, toss in oil and salt.
Roast 25 minutes at 200 °C or pan-fry 15 minutes until tender.
Heat chakalaka 3 minutes until bubbling and hot.
Divide sweet potato into bowls, top with hot chakalaka.
Add raw spinach, crumble feta over, pack for lunch.

recipes.title: Curried Samp and Bean Salad
steps: Boil samp 45 minutes if pre-soaked, drain and cool.
Drain four bean mix, rinse and drain again thoroughly.
Chop onion and tomatoes, mix with samp and beans.
Mix mayo, vinegar, curry powder, salt to make dressing.
Toss salad with dressing, chill 10 minutes, serve.

recipes.title: Mogodu Slow-Cooked Beef Tripe
steps: Rinse 1000 g tripe thoroughly under cold water.
Boil tripe in salted water 120 minutes until tender.
Heat 30 ml oil, fry 2 onions and 3 garlic cloves.
Add 400 g tomato and 2 tsp curry powder.
Add drained tripe, simmer 30 minutes low heat.
Season with 1 tsp salt, serve hot with pap.

recipes.title: Amanqina Walkie-Talkies - Township Chicken Feet
steps: Clean 1000 g chicken feet, trim nails properly.
Boil feet 60 minutes until tender and soft.
Heat 30 ml oil, fry 1 onion and 2 garlic.
Stir in 30 ml peri-peri sauce and 1 tsp salt.
Add feet, toss 10 minutes until sticky glazed.
Serve hot with pap, extra sauce if liked.

recipes.title: Morogo wa Matokomane - Peanut Greens
steps: Wash 1 bunch morogo, strip stems, chop roughly.
Heat 15 ml oil, fry 1 onion until soft.
Add 200 g tomato, cook 5 minutes.
Stir in 60 g peanut butter and 1 tsp salt.
Add morogo, wilt 8 minutes, splash water if needed.
Serve warm with pap or steamed bread.

recipes.title: Braaied Snoek with Apricot Jam Glaze
steps: Clean 1 snoek, pat dry, score skin.
Mix 60 g apricot jam, 20 ml oil, 3 garlic.
Rub snoek with 2 tsp braai-spice and 1 tsp salt.
Squeeze 1 lemon over, brush jam glaze thickly.
Braai over medium coals 15 minutes per side.
Rest 5 minutes, serve with braaied veggies.

recipes.title: Split Pea Breyani with Tomato Curry
steps: Soak 500 g split peas 30 minutes, drain well.
Boil peas in salted water 25 minutes until tender.
Heat 30 ml oil, fry 2 onions and 2 garlic.
Add 300 g tomato and 2 tsp curry powder.
Stir in 400 g rice and drained peas.
Add water to cover, simmer 20 minutes covered.
Season 1 tsp salt, fluff, serve hot.
